== Jumps.loops (line 9)
| int loops(int[] values)
  instruction
    | int sum = 0;
  for style=FREETEXT
    | for (int v : values)
    -
      alternative
        | v < 0
        -
          instruction color=ff0000 disabled
            | continue;
        -
      alternative
        | v > 100
        -
          jump
            | break
        -
      instruction
        | sum += v;
  jump
    | return sum

== Jumps.labels (line 23)
| int labels(int[][] grid)
  instruction
    | int found = -1;
  for style=FREETEXT
    | for (int i = 0; i < grid.length; i++)
    -
      for style=FREETEXT
        | for (int j = 0; j < grid[i].length; j++)
        -
          alternative
            | grid[i][j] == 0
            -
              instruction
                | found = i;
              jump
                | break outer
            -
          alternative
            | grid[i][j] < 0
            -
              instruction color=ff0000 disabled
                | continue outer;
            -
  jump
    | return found
